top_news.title: DeepSeek search and fetch – $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
top_news.dek: DeepSeek has launched Search and Fetch APIs to provide agents and RAG pipelines with real-time web access.
top_news.brief: The new Search API returns structured web results, while the Fetch API converts web pages into Markdown. Both endpoints are available via the standard DeepSeek API bearer authentication at a cost of $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests.
top_news.image_alt: DeepSeek API documentation interface showing search and fetch endpoints

top_news.title: AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it
top_news.dek: The new Taste-Bench benchmark evaluates AI agent decision-making quality in long-term tasks.
top_news.brief: Current benchmarks focus on task completion rather than strategic quality. Taste-Bench uses hindsight to grade the 'taste' of an agent's decisions, revealing that even top-tier models struggle with long-term planning, often failing to improve performance despite extended reasoning time.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual visualization of AI agent decision paths and strategic planning
